entry.title: Optimal Execution and Adverse Selection in Hawkes-Driven Limit Order Books with Rough Volatility
entry.summary:
Classical Almgren-Chriss execution assumes Brownian price impact and Poisson order flow, underestimating tail slippage during liquidity droughts. Modeling mutually exciting order arrivals via a bivariate Hawkes process coupled with fractional Hurst exponent $H \approx 0.12$, we derive closed-form Riccati execution schedules that cut implementation shortfall by $19.4\text{ bps}$.

Source: arXiv Quantitative Finance (q-fin.TR) · Tags: #quant-finance #market-design #probability-stats
